author: Rogue Hobbies
description:
I'm fairly sure that im not alone in being OBSESSED not only with Warhammer and Wargaming but also Ancient history because the two just seem to go together so well! 

And so when @oxfordarchaeology posted a short reel about a VERY familiar looking 28mm figurine they had found, complete with heroic pose and classic 80's Pre-Slotta base, I knew I had to know more about what the internet were calling 'The Worlds FIRST Warhammer Miniature'. 

So In this video I journey across the UK to meet this strangely familiar artefact from nearly 2000 years ago, to give you guys the scoop on who or WHAT the miniature is and exactly why he looks so much like he belongs in our favourite hobby....
